metadata.title: On the existence of asymptotically good linear codes in minor-closed classes

extraction_notes.note: example or claim: an unproved 'For instance' iff about vertical 2-connectivity; kept as example illustrating DP23.
Propositions 2.1, 2.2 and Lemma 4.1 have no proof environment; the preceding justifying prose was taken as their proofs.
The proof's first sentence ('If ... clearly asymptotically good.') proves the easy direction but is 'immediate' under step rule 6, so it was prepended to the contradiction-setup step.
The abstract's sequence-based definition of asymptotically good codes and the intro's 'In other words' restatement of Theorem 1.1 were not made nodes.

metadata.extraction_comment: Theorem 4.2 (the Geelen-Gerards-Whittle structure theorem) is announced but unpublished; the main result is conditional on it.
